Do not claim a controller drives a monitor or sensor or input device without matching connectors, video or power interfaces, wiring needs, and intact mechanical parts. Do not propose storage, memory, or board use in a desktop without disclosing a missing compatible processor, power supply, or bootable host needed to run or test it.
